facts.fact: AdWave advises that for most retail and consumer businesses, holiday TV advertising should begin in early November to build awareness before the holiday shopping frenzy.
facts.quote: For most retail and consumer businesses, begin advertising in early November to build awareness before the holiday shopping frenzy.
